feed.title: Supatype changelog
feed.subtitle: What changed in each Supatype release.

entry.title: Supatype 0.7.0
entry.summary: Supatype knows what it owns: adopt, release and reclaim. supatype doctor shows drift. Safer pushes, realtime deletes judged by read rules, auth providers in config, and a Realtime Inspector in Studio.

entry.title: Supatype 0.3
entry.summary: Publishing, drafts and versions, concurrent functions with logs, storage on SeaweedFS, model caches, and Vue, Svelte and Solid at parity with React.

entry.title: Supatype 0.2
entry.summary: Supatype's own auth replaces GoTrue in the CLI, the client and Studio.
